id: title:dmarticus:prefill the picked repo when a sidebar group has no folder

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop client repository selection and state preservation for cloud-only groups, supporting the warehouse ingestion workflow.
review.reason: The observed changes introduce a new optional parameter `folderRepository` across the desktop client's repository selection and navigation state. This allows the desktop application to carry an owner/repo identifier alongside a folder ID, supporting groups that do not have folders registered (cloud-only groups). The implementation propagates this value through the input prefill, P1
